name: Agents
oneLiner: Systems that pursue a goal over many steps: plan, act with tools, check the result, repeat.

analogy.text: A new employee given a goal instead of a script: they work out the steps, use the office tools and check their own work.
analogy.breaks: An employee builds judgement over months. An agent's 'experience' is only what fits in its context and memory, and it can repeat a mistake confidently.

givesAbove: Completed multi-step tasks, not just single answers.
needsBelow: Tools, retrieval and model calls arranged by Orchestration & Tooling.
